stem: Which of the following should replace sentence 3 to more effectively state the claim Gage is making in this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: In fact, the size of a community is really not that important.

options.label: B
options.text: In fact, community celebrations should be viewed as essential.

options.label: C
options.text: In fact, there are different types of community celebrations.

options.label: D
options.text: In fact, both children and adults have a great deal of fun at them.
